verses.text: Please, God, rescue me! Come quickly, LORD, and help me.
be humiliated and put to shame. May those who take delight in my trouble be turned back in disgrace.
Let them be horrified by their shame, for they said, “Aha! We’ve got him now!”
be filled with joy and gladness in you. May those who love your salvation repeatedly shout, “God is great!”
But as for me, I am poor and needy; please hurry to my aid, O God. You are my helper and my savior; O LORD, do not delay.
